title: Raw footage of our work-in-progress 2D sword beat ’em up, coming soon to Steam - Super Beatdown 2049
author: Honest-Accident-4984
selftext:
This is Super Beatdown 2049, a 2D beat ’em up debut from BartCorp Studios. Think Dragon Ball Z with swords: you fight on the ground, launch into the sky, and shoot big energy blasts, all at breakneck speed.

Wave Mode is the core. You hold out against bigger and stranger waves across six levels, from a raptor-infested lost world to Shanghai at night to a ’90s vaporwave business park where the staff, security and apparently the aerobics class have all gone insane. Every level has its own allies, dozens of enemies, and several huge and intense bosses tuned to Soulslike difficulty, forcing you to level up across attempts to make your character faster, stronger, and more explosive.

In this clip we get our butts kicked by one of the bosses, but not before whupping an adversary, slicing through some bad guys, and summoning the other playable characters to fight beside us.

Eight heroes so far, playable on controller, Windows. The Steam page is on its way.
